subject: Eligibility audit: cloud listing program (rebates & co-sell)
messages:
From: Amy Wu <amy.wu@aws-partner.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing program eligibility audit: action requested

Hi Kimberly,

Quick heads up from the marketplace team — we're kicking off a Q3 eligibility audit for partner listing benefits (rebates, co-sell credits, and promotional credits). We ran Redwood Inference through the intake and flagged two items that need verification before the window closes on Aug 20: 1) actual ARR mapped to your AWS marketplace purchase records, and 2) the product SKU mapping for your private/dedicated offering.

I've attached the eligibility matrix (aws_eligibility_matrix_v1.xlsx) — can you confirm the SKU mappings and return the filled sheet by Aug 17? If you think Redwood should be considered for an elevated rebate tier, note the supporting metrics in column H.

If you prefer, we can set a 30-min call this week to walk through the file.

Thanks,
Amy Wu
Partner Programs – AWS Marketplace
amy.wu@aws-partner.com
Attachment: aws_eligibility_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: amy.wu@aws-partner.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing program eligibility audit: action requested

Thanks Amy — looping in Laura and Marcus to triage.

Laura / Marcus — quick summary: AWS is asking us to confirm SKU mapping + ARR evidence for marketplace purchases to be eligible for certain rebates/co-sell credits. Deadline to return the matrix is Aug 17; program audit closes Aug 20.

Requested next steps (short):
- Laura: confirm SKU mappings and whether our Dedicated offering is listed as a separate SKU (see column D).
- Marcus: can you confirm finance can produce the ARR mapping to AWS purchase IDs by EOD Aug 16? If not, state what we can provide instead (invoice list, purchase order references).
- If helpful, we can take Amy up on a 30-min walk-through; I can coordinate.

Also cc'ing Soojin for billing/marketplace fee context.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing program eligibility audit: action requested

Kim — I'm on it. Quick notes after glancing at the sheet:
- Dedicated offering is listed under two SKUs historically; one is the public hosted SKU (MARK-RED-STD) and there's a private/dedicated SKU (DED-RED-PRIV). I'll confirm the exact mapping from product catalog.
- For rebate tiering, column H wants a 12-month ARR number attributable to marketplace purchases only. Finance can pull net ARR by marketplace invoice ID, but it will take until Aug 16 to reconcile (Marcus to confirm).

Marcus — please confirm whether finance can generate the invoice-level ARR extract or if we should extract PO/invoice PDFs for AWS.

Soojin — FYI, there may be an impact to our FY28 marketplace spend forecasting if we move into a higher rebate band — want your read on whether we should model conservatively.

Laura
Director, GTM Operations
From: Amy Wu <amy.wu@aws-partner.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, marketplace-ops@gcppartner.com
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing program eligibility audit: action requested

Thanks, Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications:
- Invoice-level ARR is the preferred evidence; screenshots of billing console + invoice PDFs are acceptable if invoice-level export isn't possible in time.
- If you qualify for the elevated rebate tier we can apply a retroactive adjustment for the last quarter (subject to approval).
- I've uploaded a clarified copy of the eligibility criteria and added a GCP cross-check file (listing_terms_update_gcp.pdf) for multi-cloud partners. Please review and return the completed matrix.

DocuSign link for enrollment updates: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123 (please complete if you accept the updated terms)

Attachment: listing_terms_update_gcp.pdf (PDF)

Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing program eligibility audit: action requested

Amy — thanks for the clarifications and the updated docs. Quick update from our side after internal checks:

- SKU mapping: confirmed. Dedicated offering is DED-RED-PRIV and hosted is MARK-RED-STD. I've attached the filled matrix and flagged the cells with supporting invoice IDs (see column I).
- ARR evidence: Marcus confirmed finance can provide invoice-level exports by EOD Aug 16. Marcus — please upload the export to the HubSpot record (HS: 9876543) and drop the link in JIRA PARTNER-452.
- DocuSign: we are willing to accept the updated enrollment terms, but would like a one-time marketing credit for initial listing promotion (Q4 run). Can your team confirm if a promotional credit is available or who we should escalate to?

Action items:
- Marcus: deliver invoice-level export to HS record by 2027-08-16.
- Laura: confirm nothing else outstanding in the matrix; I will return the completed file to Amy by EOD Aug 17.
- Amy/AWS: confirm whether a one-time marketing/promotional credit can be applied for new listings (Q4) and if a retroactive rebate will be processed when the elevated tier is reached.

Attachments: aws_eligibility_matrix_v1.xlsx (filled), aws_docsign_enrollment_link.txt (DocuSign link)

Thanks — Kim
